body.intent: Fix Plan-review runs of drafts bypass the kept slots: the daemon reserves a slot for a waiting plan request or queued continuation (#226, #243), but its plan-review starts (milestone 26's drafts 01M6J375, 01M6J37D on 2026-11-04) took freed slots while the request queue's head waited. Count plan-review starts as ship picks under the same shipMax, or give queued requests priority over them
